items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bruce and Thadia. They were very small at the time. Now Thadia is a pediatrician and Bruce is working in California. He is a record consultant.

ctx.x: Did Leonard Feather have a heavy hand in these things?

He may have had something to do with that, if I recall. I am certain that is how it was set up. You know, we posed for a picture at Thad’s apartment. Thad was living on the upper West side at 85th St. It was in that area east of Broadway. I guess you could call it the east side. But, there was a picture taken which is on the album cover in fact. It is our picture, the three of us. It's Thad, Elvin and I, and two of Thad’s kids. Bruce and Thadia. They were very small at the time. Now Thadia is a pediatrician and…
Yes and then there was another date that was just called, "Elvin."
